summary: Neo is running down the apartment hall when Tank, over the radio, directs him: "The door on your left." Neo kicks in an apartment door, but Tank corrects him — "No! Other left!" — and Neo wheels back to his other left, battering through that door just as it is riddled by bullets. He blurs past an old woman watching TV and into her kitchen, where another woman is chopping vegetables. Tank calls out "That window!" and Neo throws it open, leaping for the fire escape the instant a knife buries itself in the window casing. Tank then shouts "Down! Down!"

what_changes.before: Running exposed down the open hall, unsure which door to take
what_changes.after: Inside the apartment and escaping out the window onto the fire escape, out of the line of fire
what_changes.evidence: He whirls back to his other left, battering through the door which splinters, perforated by BULLETS.

what_changes.before: Misreads Tank's direction and kicks in the wrong door
what_changes.after: Corrected to the right door and then to the escape window by Tank's commands
what_changes.evidence: TANK (V.O.) No! Other left! He whirls back to his other left

event_hint.one_line: Neo flees through an apartment building while Tank guides him by radio toward an escape route.
